about_the_game:
Explore a vast underground world

After buying a plot of land from Chaos, Incorporated, you're just trying to make some dough. Whilst doing that, you find ancient civilizations, dangerous underground habitats, and various areas to uncover. Explore a society of people who aren't exactly convinced they are underground and try to befriend them or take them down. Don't worry - you just need some extra money.

Make it back to the top

You've just collected a rich, expensive ore from deep below the surface of the earth. One problem, you can't exactly sell that underground.

Getting your valuables is only half the process. Returning them to safety is another. Struggle as you make it to the top, either by foot, or whatever creative gadgets or systems you use to make that process easier. That could be a giant elevator rising to the top, a mega-cannon that launches you to the surface, or just plain old rope coil if you don't feel like all that building.

Making your way back up isn't the only challenging part. Creatures and people down here seem to be much more drawn to you when you have more valuables, and they won't be going down without a fight. Don't expect to get back up with new expensive ores without having to stand your ground to keep them.

Expand your plot - and your rank

This thin little space that Chaos, Inc. is giving you may not be enough. You can use that money of yours to expand your exploration space, but sometimes - more to deal with isn't such a good thing.

Doing a great job mining and earning that company lots of money? Hey, we might just give you a promotion. With a higher rank, you earn a higher percentage of money from the ores you collect, you are able to unlock more things, and you'll even get a little money boost.

And hey, who knows, you might even become the C.E.O. one day.

Fight your way through this unforgiving land

As you get further underground and find more things that maybe you shouldn't know about, don't expect those things to be unguarded.

Encounter various creatures and people who don't want you in their territory. Fight monsters, underground civilians, animals, and many different bosses. Almost everything down here wants you dead.

very fun :)

"Fun game, I said." - developer (very trustworthy review)

"Fire🔥" - ultra01 (the musician) (not biased)

content_descriptors.notes: There is really not much mature content, I try to keep the game family friendly.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel core i3 or equivelant
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: very small lightweight game, not much worries
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 660 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: :)

short_description: Play as a broke miner who buys a plot of land from Chaos, Inc. Explore a vast underground world with many different areas to uncover. Mine various ores and try to make it back to the surface so you can sell them and get money. Upgrade in rank and fight various enemies and bosses in Chaos Company.
